heading.en: A low-impact field routine for Sierra Nevada
heading.de: Eine rücksichtsvolle Feldroutine für Sierra Nevada

en: Protect research operations, remain outside closed facilities, follow mountain leaders, and keep lights away from roads and participants. Turn back immediately when staff, weather, or symptoms require it. Finish navigation and equipment checks before darkness, keep white light brief and directed downward, and never block gates, tracks, residences, or emergency access.

Base below the mountain, join a confirmed Hoya de la Mora event in daylight, complete its supervised ascent or viewing programme, and descend with the organised group. Set a turnaround time before the session begins and preserve enough energy for the return; the final hour should not depend on improvisation.

Schließe Navigation und Ausrüstungscheck vor Dunkelheit ab, halte Weißlicht kurz und nach unten gerichtet und blockiere niemals Tore, Wege, Wohnhäuser oder Rettungszufahrten.
